title: Among evangelicals, party predicts climate concern
subtitle: Share saying global climate change is an extremely or very serious problem, 2022
caption: Evangelical Republicans and evangelical Democrats sit 61 points apart, about as far apart as Republicans and Democrats overall. Pew found that with party and demographics held constant, evangelicals were 5 points less likely than the religiously unaffiliated to call climate change a serious problem.
note: Republicans and Democrats include those who lean toward each party. Pew's marginal effects analysis controlled for age, gender, education, race and ethnicity, income and party.

sources.study: How Religion Intersects With Americans' Views on the Environment
sources.sample: 10,156 U.S. adults on Pew's American Trends Panel
